# Veylet

> Veylet (Veylet Studio) makes 3D walkthroughs for homes, businesses and venues. Anyone with a LiDAR iPhone captures a space with the Veylet Capture app; Veylet processes and checks it automatically and hosts a walkthrough the account reviews and approves before sharing, shared as a link or a website embed that viewers open with no app. Early accounts are onboarding in south-east Queensland, Australia; no client-accepted tour is available yet.

Short answers:
- Who it is for: anyone: agents, property managers and freelancers, on the same plan and prices; there is no separate tier.
- What it is: the product is the Veylet Capture iPhone app plus automatic cloud processing. You capture; Veylet processes, checks and hosts the walkthrough automatically; you review and approve it before sharing.
- Processing: automatic, with no person checking. An automatic quality check stops a render that cannot work, such as one with no usable photos or depth, and asks for a recapture of the rooms it names; anything else it finds is flagged as worth a look for you to check before you approve. The check measures held-out photo match, coverage, floaters and walkable paths. We'll email you when it's ready. An AI visual check is planned and comes only once the privacy notice covers it; it does not run today.
- Status: early accounts are onboarding in south-east Queensland; our own captures remain under quality review and no client-accepted tour is available yet. Room images and animations on the site are labelled illustrations, not captured-property proof.
- The app: Veylet Capture is distributed by invitation through TestFlight; it is not listed on the App Store yet.
- Sending: Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status.
- Price in one line: eligible subscribers receive 1 free month with 3 accepted walkthroughs in total, then the Veylet plan through the App Store: A$139.99/month for 2 new walkthroughs each paid month (bank up to 4), or A$1,399.99 upfront/year for a 24-walkthrough annual pool (the same 2 a month) with no annual rollover. Annual saves A$279.89 (16.7%) against 12 monthly payments. Optional one-time packs and Super fast renders are separate purchases, subject to availability. Totals in AUD. Details: https://veylet.com/offer
- See a result (a public research capture processed by our pipeline, shown as a 3D walkthrough and as the walkthrough video; not a client property): https://veylet.com/see
- Viewers: tour viewers need no app. Studio visits are not currently offered.
- Contact: yoda@yodalai.xyz

## Guides
Sourced answers, checked 24 September 2026. Index: https://veylet.com/guides
- What is a 3D walkthrough? https://veylet.com/guides/what-is-a-3d-walkthrough — A 3D walkthrough is an interactive 3D reconstruction of a real space, explored in a browser. How it differs from a 360° tour and a video, and its limits.
- What does a 3D tour cost in Australia? https://veylet.com/guides/3d-tour-cost-australia — Published 3D tour prices in Australia, checked 24 September 2026: photographers, Matterport and iGUIDE, and what makes one quote higher than another.
- iPhone LiDAR or a dedicated 3D camera? https://veylet.com/guides/iphone-lidar-vs-matterport — A LiDAR iPhone Pro can capture smaller homes and simpler spaces for a 3D tour; a dedicated camera like Matterport’s Pro3 reaches further but costs more.
- Is it safe to put a 3D tour of your home online? https://veylet.com/guides/privacy-3d-home-tour — It can be. Clear names, documents, screens and valuables before capture, check every room before release, and share by a private link you can switch off.
- Will a 3D tour show on realestate.com.au or Domain? https://veylet.com/guides/3d-tours-realestate-com-au-domain — realestate.com.au shows 3D tours only from listed suppliers and Domain bundles Matterport; share a Veylet walkthrough by private link or on your own site.
- Do 3D tours help a property sell or lease faster? https://veylet.com/guides/do-3d-tours-help-sell-faster — Zillow and Matterport report faster sales with 3D tours, but a Harvard study of 75,178 sales found little effect once photo quality was counted.

## Free months
- Capture with a LiDAR iPhone.
- 1 month free with 3 accepted walkthroughs in total for eligible App Store subscribers, starting on activation. Apple confirms eligibility, local price and renewal date. Existing signed offers keep their dates and allowances.
- The first charge is on the day the free months end, at the price of the plan chosen; cancelling before then charges nothing.
- One trial per agency (ABN) and workspace; real captures unlock in the app once the practice room passes.
- This website does not offer new recurring card subscriptions.
- App Store subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled through Apple. Existing website card subscriptions retain their agreed automatic renewal; studio invoice periods require explicit agreement and settlement and do not auto-renew.
- The full amount and date are disclosed before activation; cancel any time.
- A reminder email 7 days before the first charge is planned but not running yet; check the date in the account or in Apple subscription settings.
- More walkthroughs inside the free months come from a walkthrough pack (below), which can be bought during the free months; the free-months end date stays the same.

## Plans and prices (AUD)
- Recurring monthly capacity is not available yet, with planned full totals of A$219.99/month for 4 new walkthroughs each paid month and a bank of 8; A$319.99/month for 6 and a bank of 12. These replace the base capacity choice, not separate additive subscriptions. No annual capacity price or purchase option is available; a future annual capacity option would use the same annual bill.
- One plan, the Veylet plan, monthly or annual through the App Store. Monthly: A$139.99 a month with 2 new accepted walkthroughs each paid month; bank up to 4 unused. Annual: A$1,399.99 upfront a year with a pool of 24 to use any time in the paid plan year; no monthly limit and no rollover between plan years. Annual is A$279.89 (16.7%) less than 12 monthly payments. Unlimited seats and hosting of released walkthroughs while the plan runs.
- Per walkthrough, when every included walkthrough is used: A$70.00 on monthly (A$139.99 for 2 a month), A$58.33 on annual (A$1,399.99 for 24 a year). For comparison, a photographer's 3D tour costs A$215–400 each (published prices of Brisbane and Gold Coast 3D tour photographers, checked 13 September 2026; see the 3D tour cost guide below).
- Super fast render: A$29 a capture, on the website only: rendered on the fastest GPU available in Australia and first in the queue: ready in about 30 minutes, any day, any time, or the A$29 is refunded automatically if it isn't ready within 30 minutes of the upload finishing or your purchase, whichever is later. When a bonus Super fast render was used, it is returned instead. No daily limit and no business hours. Super fast is sold only while its availability gate is green: the 7-day Sydney GPU-start probe shows starts within 5 minutes at the 90th percentile; until the probe has data, the account says "Super fast isn't available right now" and nothing is charged. An order already paid keeps its promise. Not sold in the app.
- First walkthrough: if an account's first walkthrough isn't listing-ready, we redo it free. The redo is a correction on the same link and uses no walkthrough; a new capture visit is not included.
- One-time walkthrough packs for busier months (not recurring capacity): 3 walkthroughs for A$169 or 10 walkthroughs for A$499 (website and studio invoice prices), each valid 12 months after purchase and used only after the included walkthroughs of the free months or the plan. The account owner can buy one during the free months or on the plan: by studio invoice today, or by card in the account once card payment opens. In-app purchase arrives in a later app version.
- The App Store sells the Veylet plan monthly and annual.
- Referrals: when an office you refer becomes a paying account, you each get 1 bonus walkthrough. Share your own link from your account.
- New subscriptions use Apple. Existing signed agreements retain their terms. Apple programme enrolment and net proceeds are not verified.
- Founding agencies (by invitation only, at most five): the normal plan and pack prices, with no locked or special price. Perks: priority rendering, a free 3-pack for each referred office that becomes a paying account (up to four), and a direct line to the founder. There is nothing to sign up for.
- Hosting: every released walkthrough stays live while the account has an active plan (free months, monthly or annual). When the plan ends, its links, embeds and QR codes keep working for 14 days, then go offline; they are not deleted or revoked, and restarting the plan brings the same links back at once. To keep a single walkthrough online without a plan, ask us for a hosting extension: A$49 a year per walkthrough.
- While subscribed: use the link anywhere, embed it on any website, and add the listing URL to portals and CRMs. Making listing videos for realestate.com.au and social media comes once video exports open: listing videos (MP4) and stills are included in the plan once video exports open, and downloaded files are the account's to keep.
- Additional work by agreement: editing A$120 an hour. In-person capture and office visits are not currently offered.
- Totals in AUD.

## What counts
- An accepted walkthrough is one the automatic quality check passed and the account approved for release; a failed capture never counts.
- One new accepted capture uses one walkthrough, regardless of room count. Each capture has one link and one QR code. Rooms are counted automatically from the capture; nothing is declared. The app shows how many rooms fit in one capture; a home with more rooms takes more captures, and each is its own walkthrough with its own link. Corrections to the same walkthrough do not use a second unit, and neither does a permitted whole recapture including every original room; both keep the same link.
- Pack walkthroughs are added only once the pack's payment has settled; there is no automatic debt. New subscriptions use Apple and have no early paid trial switch. Existing card or invoice trials may start paid service early only with separate consent under their agreed terms; using the allowance never starts billing automatically.
- Route checks in the app do not prove quality; the automatic quality check after upload assesses the capture.

## Waitlist, applications and accounts
- Joining the waitlist and applying as a partner are free.
- Applying is free assessment. It does not create an account, grant app access, take payment, or promise jobs, leads or earnings.
- Scope, capture authority, exclusions, quote, hosting dates and sharing approval are confirmed separately before the corresponding work.
- Enquiries and applications use FormSubmit; a return page is not proof of inbox delivery.
- New subscriptions start in the app through the App Store. No new Square recurring subscription or automatic transfer from Apple is offered. Existing card or invoice agreements keep their terms. Buying a separate service cannot automatically pause or cancel an Apple subscription.
- Email accounts are free. New accounts are admitted in weekly groups from the waitlist; for help, contact Veylet support at yoda@yodalai.xyz.
- Production capture needs assessment; capture, processing, hosting and invited pilot allowances require agreed scope. Phone recording does not automatically reconstruct a tour.
